name: HYDRA-UMC-TELEMETRY-COLLECTOR
build: Go module root is src/. Run go build ./... from inside src/.
notes: Real CAN/WebSocket ingestion pipeline with a bounded buffer, retry-on-outage delivery, and a real DatalakeSink writing to HYDRA-UMC-DATALAKE - verified end-to-end. Real per-producer sequence deduplication with a bounded reorder window (dedup.Tracker) so a reconnect resend never inflates ingest counts, and a real transport-vs-invalid-data error classification on flush failures (sink.InvalidDataError) for real operational diagnosis.
